The Tehov park hosted another day camp organised by Bikeskills and the MTB Trial Mraveniště club. The organising team has been stable for a few years now and instructors Katarína and Matěj know their job. Carers Lucka and Lenka fill the free time and treat any injuries that turn up.

This year a decent bunch of young guns of both sexes came together. The progress was really noticeable – unfortunately at the cost of two injuries (a split eyebrow and a concussion), which is part of riding bikes. Fortunately everything ended well with no lasting consequences. The weather was ideal and the kids managed everything physically too. Vlasta organised a small training session for the Trial riders taking part and, the next day, a somewhat more extreme ride for the older boys.
